_note: Lake trout (Salvelinus namaycush), a rare fish of cold, deep northern Michigan lakes such as Burt Lake. Markings from field-guide descriptions: a long, streamlined char; dark grey-green covered in pale cream spots (light spots on a dark ground, head and fins included), a pale belly, a big mouth reaching past the eye, a small adipose fin, white leading edges on the lower fins, and a deeply forked tail.
name: Lake trout
